ridSelection.graphDirection: distro-specific RIDs import linux-x64; linux-x64 imports linux
ridSelection.exactAssetPriority: exact RID assets are preferred before imported fallback assets
ridSelection.packageReferencePolicy: package IDs are explicit; managed package does not auto-select a runtime package
ridSelection.previewPolicy: linux-x64 preview may be referenced only by explicit preview consumers

requiredEvidence.targetUserspace: exact distro/version image or host identity
requiredEvidence.glibcSymbolFloor: measured GLIBC symbol versions from every shipped ELF
requiredEvidence.nativeExportClosure: 2663 Full and 527 Mini wrapper ABI functions with export/dependency audit
requiredEvidence.profileParity: Full and Mini module, payload, and consumer contracts remain distinct and complete
requiredEvidence.packageConsumer: same-run managed/runtime packages restored by an independent linux-x64 consumer
requiredEvidence.nativeSmoke: loader call and representative core/imgproc/imgcodecs/videoio smoke without LD_LIBRARY_PATH
requiredEvidence.dependencyClosure: glibc, libstdc++, codec, and optional-module dependencies resolved without producer paths
requiredEvidence.provenance: source commit, SDK/toolchain, package hashes, artifact hashes, and runner identity

promotionGates: Do not add linux-x64 to the active package matrix before all three reference distributions pass.
Measure the lowest GLIBC symbol version in every shipped ELF and compare it with the proposed baseline.
Build and consume Full and Mini separately; a Full result cannot promote Mini.
Restore only the same-run managed/runtime packages in an independent consumer process.
Execute native smoke through the packaged loader without LD_LIBRARY_PATH, producer PATH, or runtime-root overrides.
Record dependency closure, source/toolchain identity, package hashes, and runner/userspace facts.
Keep distro-specific package identities as the rollback path until a later release review approves promotion.

rollback.onFailure: retain distro-specific package identities and mark linux-x64 preview evidence failed
